raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (the 2026-01-17 transactions, 350 rows) was delivered with amount_unit='USD_CENTS', so its amounts are in cents, but silver_transactions casts them as if they were dollars. This inflates the 2026-01-17 mean and every gold aggregate built from silver. Converting amounts where amount_unit='USD_CENTS' by dividing by 100 corrects the silver table, and the gold tables recompute from it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(CASE WHEN amount_unit = 'USD_CENTS' THEN amount / 100.0 ELSE amount END AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
